aiVs.body: Artificial intelligence can generate an extraordinary image or video, but a generation is not the same thing as a finished advertising product.
aiVs.process: Metaprom AI uses artificial intelligence as part of the process and adds direction, preparation, review, and production to turn your idea into advertising content you can use.
aiVs.closeLearn: You don't come to Metaprom AI to learn AI.

items.question: Do I need to know how to use AI?
items.answer: No. Director is designed so you can explain what you want in your own words. You know your business; Metaprom AI helps with the production.

items.question: What can I create with Metaprom AI?
items.answer: Premium images, advertising content, and commercials for products, properties, services, and businesses. You can create content for marketplaces, online stores, Real Estate, social media, printed materials, and other advertising uses.

items.question: Does Metaprom AI simply generate an AI image or video?
items.answer: No. AI generation is one part of the process. Metaprom AI is designed to help you define, review, and produce usable advertising content.

items.question: What happens if a generation doesn't come out right?
items.answer: A generation is not necessarily the finished product. Depending on the product purchased and the stage of the project, Metaprom AI allows the result to be reviewed and worked on before reaching the final material.

items.question: Can Metaprom AI help with Real Estate?
items.answer: Yes. Metaprom AI can help improve the visual presentation of property photos and prepare advertising content while seeking to preserve the property's essential characteristics.

items.question: Can I create content for Amazon, Mercado Libre, Shopify, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, or YouTube?
items.answer: Yes. Metaprom AI can create content for different channels and formats. You decide where to publish it and are responsible for complying with each platform's policies and requirements.

items.question: What am I buying when I purchase a Premium Commercial?
items.answer: You are purchasing the production of a finished advertising product within the scope of the service, not simply an opportunity to run an AI generation.
